source: sandbox-ai's local-model research, rounds 1-6 (2026-11-15/20: LM Studio on an Apple-silicon Mac; docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md). Round 5 measured each use case with its own tasks and graders ('measured'); 'indirect' marks a choice that rests on other tasks. Only what a run showed is written down.

use_cases.label: Coding and debugging
use_cases.about: Find and fix a bug in a repository: read code and logs, edit, run the tests (the research's debugging task: a misleading crash, two root causes, a 2 MB log).
unknown: servers other than LM Studio (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM): not measured
